description: `presence` loads no config (not even `_load(args)`) and reports Mike's local HID idle signal by shelling out to the real `ioreg -c IOHIDSystem` (cli.py's `_hid_idle_seconds`) with no env override and no test hook — unlike every other host-dependent probe this harness works around (the pmset idle-sleep line `check` drops, per README), `ioreg`'s actual idle counter is read for real here because the sandbox's curated PATH falls through to the real `/usr/sbin/ioreg` and there is no scenario-schema mechanism to shadow it (projects/dirs only populate their own trees, never the harness's own `sandbox/bin`). So `idle_seconds` and `status` (active/away/unknown) are genuinely non-deterministic from one run to the next, including within the same harness pass — this scenario therefore omits `exit` entirely (optional per run_scenario.py) and asserts only the stable, value-independent shape of both output modes, never a value. Same category of gap as the README's documented pmset-line and elapsed-time-display notes.
